This yields a dual-voltage plateau, ~408 mAh g⁻¹ capacity, and 50,000-cycle stability, offering a rational design strategy for high-voltage, long-life iodine chemistry.

item.title: Supercapacitors Under Nonequilibrium Conditions: Mechanisms and Design Principles
item.description:
این مرور، سازوکارهای حاکم بر ابرخازن‌ها در شرایط دور از تعادل را تحلیل می‌کند و سه منشأ تخریب یعنی ناهم‌ترازی انتقال، ناپایداری سطح مشترک و جفت‌شدگی گرمامکانیکی را شناسایی کرده و اصول طراحی مواد ارائه می‌دهد.
Advanced Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely unifies supercapacitor behavior under nonequilibrium operation—floating, high-frequency, wide-temperature, high-voltage—linking coupled kinetic-thermodynamic processes across scales. It identifies three degradation origins (transport mismatch, interfacial instability, thermo-mechanical coupling) and derives design principles for ion transport, interfacial chemistry, electrolyte optimization, and structural adaptability, bridging laboratory evaluation and real-world dynamic energy storage applications.
🏷 supercapacitors · nonequilibrium operation · ion transport · interfacial instability · degradation mechanisms

💡 The novelty lies in explaining why series-connected LiFePO₄ cells diverge in voltage during constant-voltage charging despite fixed pack voltage. item.title: Simultaneously harnessing interfacial molecular layer and solvation structure for highly reversible and stable zinc metal anodes
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in simultaneously engineering both the interfacial molecular layer and the solvation structure of the electrolyte—a dual-regulation strategy rather than a single-factor approach. This synergy suppresses dendrite growth and parasitic reactions, enabling highly reversible and stable zinc metal anodes. Its significance is providing a rational design principle for durable, practical aqueous zinc-based batteries.
🏷 zinc metal anode · solvation structure · interfacial molecular layer · dendrite suppression · zinc battery
